_doc: Curated official statements. Automated official items (Telegram, embassy feed, WHO) are merged in at build time. `via` notes when we cite a report of the statement rather than the primary document.

title.en: Checks complete: no dangerous pathogens; “second case” is fake

points.en: Two biosafety commissions found no accident

points.en: Calls for timely, complete and transparent information-sharing

points.en: Russia reports no plague case registered in Irkutsk oblast

points.zh: 所有接触者均已识别并接受监测，未出现症状，未检出危险病原体
points.en: All contacts identified and monitored; none symptomatic; no dangerous pathogens detected

points.zh: 风险：伊尔库茨克中低 · 俄罗斯低 · 欧洲区域极低
points.en: Risk: Irkutsk moderate-to-low · Russia low · European Region very low

points.zh: 知悉有关疑似肺鼠疫及医院检疫的媒体报道

points.zh: 建议遵循当地卫生部门指导，避开受影响设施，出现发热或呼吸道症状时及时就医
